say:0:1030406001:0.text: I heard Mage Merlin could conjure up a rabbit out of thin air...
say:0:1030406001:0.source_cn: 听说梅林法师能从空中变出兔子……
say:0:1030406001:0.male: I heard Mage Merlin could conjure up a rabbit out of thin air...
say:0:1030406001:0.female: I heard Mage Merlin could conjure up a rabbit out of thin air...

say:1:1030406002:0.text: I also heard he likes to put a sock on his head!
say:1:1030406002:0.source_cn: 我还听说他喜欢把袜子套在头上！
say:1:1030406002:0.male: I also heard he likes to put a sock on his head!
say:1:1030406002:0.female: I also heard she likes to put a sock on her head!

say:2:1030406003:0.text: Is there really a man like this in the world?
say:2:1030406003:0.male: Is there really a man like this in the world?
say:2:1030406003:0.female: Is there really a woman like this in the world?
